links.outcome: Time delay between radiograph acquisition and availability of AI report in ED workflow
links.effect: Value stream analyses showed a 6-23 min delay between radiograph acquisition and availability of the AI report; authors note workflow integration still requires improvement.
links.quote: Value stream analyses showed a delay of 6-23 min between radiograph acquisition and availability of the AI report.

screen.reason: This empirical study evaluates the real-world deployment, workflow integration, and clinician perceptions of an AI fracture detection tool in two emergency departments.
